The Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth support programme workers staging that protest outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday and announcing a 24-hour strike are playing right into a carefully scripted theater. The government claims it has already delivered on the most significant demands, which is a classic inversion designed to cover up the real agenda of the hidden elites pulling the strings of these institutions. Every single denial and public reassurance from the authorities just proves they are coordinating a deeper manipulation of the workforce.
